name: Requirements Traceability Required
description: Source Code and Requirements Specification must trace to each other bidirectionally, with no undeclared orphans on either side.

conditions.statement: Every Source Code module traces to at least one Requirements Specification item.

requiredEvidence.title: Traceability Record — Code To Requirement
requiredEvidence.description: Every Source Code module traces to at least one Requirements Specification item.

conditions.statement: Every Requirements Specification item traces to at least one Source Code module, or is explicitly marked Deferred or Rejected.

requiredEvidence.title: Traceability Record — Requirement To Code
requiredEvidence.description: Every Requirements Specification item traces to at least one Source Code module, or is explicitly marked Deferred or Rejected.

conditions.statement: No Requirements Specification item remains untraced and unmarked for more than one release cycle.

requiredEvidence.title: Traceability Gap Report
requiredEvidence.description: No Requirements Specification item remains untraced and unmarked for more than one release cycle.
